Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest

Class CapabilityAndPersistenceGameTests

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest.CapabilityAndPersistenceGameTests
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.fabricmc.fabric.api.gametest.v1.FabricGameTest
public final class CapabilityAndPersistenceGameTests extends Object implements net.fabricmc.fabric.api.gametest.v1.FabricGameTest
The automation surface and the saved state behind it: the whole-run storage exposed on every side, a run advertising its reachable headroom, and each type's update tag round-tripping the contents and presentation state it is responsible for.

    • itemStorageIsAvailableFromEverySide

      public void itemStorageIsAvailableFromEverySide(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Internal Fabric lookup check: query all six sides and the unsided storage of each stack type; every lookup must expose item storage.

      To check manually, place each type with one admissible item and attach a Transfer API machine to each face in turn. Each attachment can access contents. The unsided lookup is internal.

    • singleBlockStorageAdvertisesConfiguredHeadroom

      public void singleBlockStorageAdvertisesConfiguredHeadroom(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Internal Fabric slot-count check: single Storage, Singles, and Bar blocks advertise two blocks of slots when maximum height exceeds one, otherwise one. This does not commit growth.

      Nearest manual check: inspect slot counts with Transfer API automation at max_pile_height above one and then at one. Growth itself is covered by the growth tests.

    • simulatedInsertionDoesNotMutateAnyStack

      public void simulatedInsertionDoesNotMutateAnyStack(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Internal Fabric transaction-abort check, exercising Singles only: offer five apples at grounded slot 0 through the simulation helper. The returned remainder is four, while abort leaves the input and storage unchanged.

      There is no player gesture for an aborted Transfer API transaction; use a machine or test probe that offers then aborts without committing.
